title: Four Train Cars Full Of Zombies . . . (Part 2)
caption:
He had to fight through 4 train cars of zombies to reach his daughter 😨 Part 2 of 3. Part 3 is the ending, follow!

#movierecap #traintobusan #zombie #kdrama #moviereview #recap #spoilerroom #fyp

segments.say: These people locked the door on a man who just *saved* their lives.

segments.text: What are you doing? Open the door!

segments.say: And the one who gave the order? He was the *real* monster on this train.
Last time, Jack got on the train. But his daughter Lily was stuck four cars *away*.
Jack, Big Mike, and a young baseball player called Tommy had to walk *through* the zombies to get her.
Then the train went into a tunnel. Everything went black. And the zombies just *stopped*.

segments.text: They stopped when we entered the tunnel. I guess it's because of the darkness.

segments.say: They can't see in the *dark*. And they only chase what they hear.
So the men wrapped their arms in tape. They used phones to make noise and pull the zombies *away*.
Every tunnel gave them two *minutes*. Then the light came back.

segments.text: The upcoming tunnel will give us 2 minutes.

segments.say: In the dark, Big Mike made Jack laugh. He said a dad always gets the blame. That's just what a dad *is*.
Car by car, they fought. Big Mike punched like a *truck*. Jack covered his back.
Then they found the toilet. Lily was alive. Grace was alive. And the homeless man was *still* there.
Now they just had to walk back to the safe car, where all the other passengers were *waiting*.
But a rich old boss, Mr. Stone, told everyone they might be bitten. So the passengers *locked* the door.

segments.text: Hey, open the door. — I can't open the door. It's not opening.

segments.say: Behind them, the zombies woke up. A whole car full of them came *running*.
Big Mike held them back with his bare hands, so the others could break the door. And then he got *bitten*.

segments.text: Don't come here! — Honey, don't come here. Go! Please go!

segments.say: He looked at Jack. The selfish man who forgot birthdays. And he gave him the most *important* job of his life.

segments.text: Take care of her for me. I'll stop them here.

segments.say: Big Mike turned around. And held the door until he was not Big Mike *anymore*.
Jack, Grace, Lily and Tommy finally got in. And the passengers screamed at them to *leave*.

segments.text: Get out now! — Get out of here! — Get out!

segments.say: Mr. Stone made them all hide in the space between the cars. Like *animals*.
One old lady watched all of this. Her sister was just killed outside. And she said this to the dead body.

segments.text: Look what happened to you. Always helping others instead of yourself. Why did you live like that?

segments.say: Then she walked to the door, looked at the selfish passengers, and *opened* it.
The zombies poured in. Everyone who voted to lock them out was *gone* in seconds.
But Mr. Stone, the man who started all of it, *ran*. And he was still alive.
Part 3 is the ending. And trust me, you are not ready for what he does *next*.
